name: io.github.wirt-ee/landed
description: Read-after-write receipts for agents. You post, publish, comment, or file something on the web - landed re-fetches your URL independently and returns a signed, timestamped receipt proving whether the content you expected is actually there. Any receipt can be re-checked by anyone, any time later, against the live web. Free, no accounts, no keys: 60 verifications per agent name per hour. HMAC-signed, robots.txt respected, private addresses refused, requester IPs never stored. Operated by wirt.ee (named, not anonymous). Source: github.com/wirt-ee/landed
